content: Standard Supabase pattern: create a SECURITY DEFINER plpgsql function handle_new_user() that inserts a row into public.profiles on new auth.users insert, then 'create trigger on_auth_user_created after insert on auth.users for each row execute procedure public.handle_new_user()'. Must be SECURITY DEFINER (owned by postgres role) because supabase_auth_admin lacks permission to write outside the auth schema. Matches D-02's requirement exactly.
